title: Untitled Job
description:
VitaDAO is a global community of longevity enthusiasts, researchers, and contributors working to identify, fund, and incubate research in longevity science. In the past year we have funded more than 15 ageing research projects and initiatives, sponsored multiple longevity conferences, and provided travel grants to early-stage researchers.  We invite you to explore our website at https://www.vitadao.com/.

As part of of 2023 strategic plan we are endeavoring to tackle a messaging problem - legitimate longevity science driven by highly accomplished Ph.D. researchers is being intermixed with social media and fad "experts" and non-verifiable science. This, we believe is making it difficult for the general public to appreciate the work being done in the longevity science space.

Additionally the marketing of supplements, cremes, and a number of cosmetic "therapies" many of which are of questionable effect,  are diluting and in some cases outright discrediting the field. We seek to regain control of the narrative and give the general public an honest view of the science that is happening right now in the space focused on improved healthspan and ultimately lifespan.

As part of this process, and recognizing that those within our eco-system are already sold on the benefits of longevity science we need to establish how best to communicate outward to the general public about the field of longevity research.

This first survey is to be designed (and will be implemented in SurveyMonkey) with the goal of identifying the concerns/blockers of the general public towards extending lifespan through science.

Examples of some of the arguments against this kind of research that we often get are:

•Overpopulation / Resource Scarcity, 
•The notion that aging must lead to poor health and frailty, 
•Preventing death isn't moral or "natural". 

We need to establish both the policy concerns, but also looking for insight on how to make the topic personally relevant.

This job is to design the survey which will then be implemented using the SurveyMonkey service by our team. . We are looking for expertise in question development/answer format to help us formulate our strategy.

As part of of 2023 strategic plan we are endeavoring to tackle a messaging problem - legitimate longevity science driven by highly accomplished Ph.D. researchers is being intermixed with social media and fad "experts" and non-verifiable science. This, we believe is making it difficult for the general public to appreciate the work being done in the longevity science space.

Additionally the marketing of supplements, cremes, and a number of cosmetic "therapies" many of which are of questionable effect,  are diluting and in some cases outright discrediting the field. We seek to regain control of the narrative and give the general public an honest view of the science that is happening right now in the space focused on improved healthspan and ultimately lifespan.

As part of this process, and recognizing that those within our eco-system are already sold on the benefits of longevity science we need to establish how best to communicate outward to the general public about the field of longevity research.

This first survey is to be designed (and will be implemented in SurveyMonkey) with the goal of identifying the concerns/blockers of the general public towards extending lifespan through science.

Examples of some of the arguments against this kind of research that we often get are:

•Overpopulation / Resource Scarcity, 
•The notion that aging must lead to poor health and frailty, 
•Preventing death isn't moral or "natural". 

We need to establish both the policy concerns, but also looking for insight on how to make the topic personally relevant.

This job is to design the survey which will then be implemented using the SurveyMonkey service by our team. . We are looking for expertise in question development/answer format to help us formulate our strategy.

description:
Project Overview:

The Home Construction Assistant is a computer vision based application aimed at helping people who are constructing a home or any building. The idea behind this project is to provide an easy and efficient way for people to get instant feedback on their construction work. By simply taking a picture of the current construction status and uploading it to the application, users will receive an analysis of what needs to be done to complete the construction process successfully.

Key Features:

Picture Upload: Users can easily upload pictures of their construction work and get instant feedback.

Image Analysis: The application uses computer vision techniques to analyze the uploaded image and identify any discrepancies in the construction work.

Recommendations: Based on the analysis, the application provides recommendations on what needs to be done to complete the construction work as per industry standards.

Progress Tracking: Users can track the progress of their construction work by regularly uploading pictures and receiving recommendations.

Expert Feedback: The application also provides an option for users to connect with a construction expert for further feedback and advice.

Technical Requirements:

Image Analysis: The application should use computer vision techniques such as object detection, image classification, and image segmentation to analyze the uploaded images.

Database: The application should have a database to store the uploaded images and analysis results.

User Interface: The application should have a user-friendly interface that allows users to easily upload pictures and view analysis results.

Target Audience:

Home Builders: This application is specifically targeted at people who are constructing a home or building.

DIY enthusiasts: People who are interested in building their homes on their own can also benefit from this application.

Construction Companies: Construction companies can also use this application to ensure that their construction work is on track and meets industry standards.

Deliverables:

Complete source code for the Home Construction Assistant application.

User manual for the application.

Technical documentation for the application, including a description of the computer vision techniques used.

Deployment instructions for the application, including instructions for setting up the database and web server.

The Home Construction Assistant is a cutting-edge application that leverages the power of computer vision to make the construction process easier and more efficient. If you are a computer vision expert, we would love to have you on board to bring this project to life!

title: Untitled Job
description:
We recently launched a new website:
https://libertyfinancialnews.com/

We are looking for a person to write factual articles on political news with financial market relevance, e.g. elections, trade policies, anti-trust regulation, opinion polls, political polls, legislature, geopolitics and political leadership.

You will base your articles on primary sources like press releases, public statements and websites of governments, parties and non-commercial organisations.

This is an excellent opportunity for a young person who wants to build a name as a world-class journalist. You must have a degree in journalism, political science, finance or economics.

You are free to seek other opportunities in journalism while writing for Liberty Financial News (LFN), and you can freely refer to the articles we have published in your LFN Profile Name in order to promote yourself.

We will only consider native English speakers based in the UK, the US, Canada or Australia.

Article Focus

Liberty Financial News primarily targets readers in the UK, the EU and the US, so this will be your geographical focus, as well as reporting on significant global stories. 
Our typical readers are investors, business leaders, entrepreneurs, students, politicians and financial news "junkies". Therefore, your reports must provide these reader groups with information they value.
Your articles must always align with our Editorial Mission:
https://libertyfinancialnews.com/editorial-mission/
Importantly, all articles must be centred around factual data. 
We do not publish opinion pieces!

Base Pay

We operate with milestones of 10 articles each and pay $25 per published article. Ten days after each 10-article milestone is reached, we will pay $250. At the end of each milestone, we set up a new one if both parties wish to do so.

Bonus Pay

Bonus

LFN readers can star rate articles on our website. If a report posted in your LFN Profile Name receives at least 10 reader votes by the 10th day (at 09:00 UTC) after first posting, then a 4-star article will receive a $5 bonus and a 5-star article will receive a $10 bonus. Any post is considered a 5-star if the average vote score is 4.5 or higher and a 4-star if the score is between 3.5 and 4.4.
The bonus payment earned for each milestone is paid ten days after each milestone.
Thus, the minimum pay for a 10-article milestone is $250 (10 x $25), and the max pay is $350 (10 x $25 + 10 x $10).

Termination

The project will be ongoing until either party decides to terminate the work. If either party ends the job before reaching a milestone, LFN will still pay $25 for each article that has been published up to that point, but no bonus.

Requirements and Restrictions

Articles can be anywhere between 800 and 2,000 words. The article must include a headline (maximum 7 words) and an excerpt (maximum 25 words) and be properly organised with sub-headlines and paragraphs.

The articles must also comply with the LFN Terms & Conditions for appropriate content ("RoUE"). Importantly, if your reports are found to include false statements of facts or content breaching third-party copyrights, you agree to refund LFN the payment for such articles. This means that your articles must be based on information from primary and open sources. You cannot copy content from other news outlets or commercial data providers.

We do not accept articles with content produced by AI text generators or scraping!

We only pay for articles that are published. If you submit an article and we decide not to publish it within ten days of submission, you are free to publish the article anywhere else. 

Once published, LFN will retain full ownership of the article and all associated data. This means you cannot submit content you have published anywhere else and cannot use the content for publications anywhere else in the future. 

You should check your articles in Grammarly before submitting them. Use the setting for knowledgeable readers. LFN checks all submitted articles in Grammarly Premium and only accepts articles with a 90% overall score.

You must include the source links for all your facts at the end of the article, and all factual statements must be properly referenced, e.g. "PM Sunak stated..." or "According to a 2021 report from the UN,...".

You must submit your report in an MS Word file. Any images for your article should be in JPEG/JPG format. If you have a table or a chart for the article, you must email the Excel file with the data, and LFN will develop the image to comply with the LFN design style and image optimisation. We will use a featured image from our databases if you cannot provide a suitable image. If you provide an image from a third party, you must ensure it is open source or otherwise free to use on our website.

LFN Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy apply to this work:
https://libertyfinancialnews.com/terms-and-conditions/
https://libertyfinancialnews.com/privacy-policy/

Communication will primarily be by email.

description:
I am in need of a consultant or project workflow analyst that can review our current task performed manually and help determine the most cost-effective methods to efficiently automate the processes using our current platforms (teamwork and ZOHO CRM) or new technologies as recommended that can integrate with TW or ZOHO. 

We analyze the operations of niche healthcare businesses to determine the fair market value of these businesses based on the financial performance of the business and other metrics. 

Currently, much of the data is manually entered from forms into an excel spreadsheet where it is then manually reviewed against hundreds of data points for consistency. A list of questions is then created for the selling client against the data supplied. This data is then updated and a recommended listing price is provided to the client. The client then confirms the listing price and the data is then exported to a detailed business information package (PDF) that can then be shared with prospective buyers. 

I believe with the advent of AI that much of this can be automated to be performed autonomously and more accurately. In an ideal world- the AI (if used to manage this) would be able to learn from past clients and apply the same logic moving forward.

I do need this to be scalable and adaptable due to the ever-changing nature of the industry. 

Am I asking too much? 

Things that need to work together with this: Analysis of data from ZOHO CRM, Teamwork, Outlook. We also hold a plethora of data in other excel and google spreadsheets. 

In Short- I want to take ME out of the process as much as possible and Insert Automation and AI to perform the vast majority of the data analysis and presentation. 

Thanks for taking this much time. I have attached a video that shows the basics of what I do. But ultimately- I think someone would need to review the daily workflow I do to help determine the ways this can be automated.

description:
Hi there, looking for help in a Transshipment blending problem. I am moving materials from a Location A to a Location B, and then to a Location C. There are different number of stocks in each location. Location A receives materials from different sources (provided).

The material (soil) in stocks at Location B and C needs to meet some grade requirements. There are transport capacity limit between Location A to Location B, and Location B to Location C.

As this is also a schedule problem, the model will need to be able to ingest expected material for Location A, and modelled the plan/schedule for 30 days for Location B and C.

I would like to transcribe it to an optimization language ideally using CPLEX/Gurobi/Python which keeps the mathematical structure (ideally a free web-based language like Google Colab).

Please advise if you have experience in this area so I can give you more details and we can set a job?

title: Untitled Job
description:
We are looking to host our own machine learning system and train a model toward predicting ideal parameters based on historical data for optimizing the quality of output within a given range.  

We have about 200 runs of processing a given food and each time an expert has been able to manually discern the optimal parameters with a high degree of success based on initial variables.  To oversimplify: If the food has a weight of x, a color of y, and a moisture level of z, then the settings for the processing which are believed to be ideal are a,b,c.  Realistically there are likely 10-20 of each parameter.  ( 30 - 60 total in MVP ) 

We have example test data of runs that did not go well also and wish to train an ai model based on this data to predict based on the initial variables the ideal variables which will produce the intended outcome. 

We will need a simple UI web interface for this but that part is handled, and we will need to store the data in a secure back end in a decentralized system that enables data sharding, but that will be a separate project which does not require much consideration for the ai aspect of the project. 

There is a preference to avoid reliance upon 3rd party solutions for this build although the cost impact of that is a variable worth considering.  We are looking for solutions that minimize reliance on 3rd party systems, for example, we are opting for a decentralized back-end solution and on building our own user auth instead of using existing auth packages, as there is a belief that this will make the end product more resilient. 

This also means that instead of using a cloud computing option for the machine learning system we will need to set up our own server.  We have a technically capable team on the ground who can take care of this, and if that setup causes a delay we can start in a cloud service and transfer to our physically siloed environment. 

We are looking for an estimation of cost in a rough sense of the project as a whole, and professional opinions about how likely we are to achieve useable data outputs with such a limited initial set of training data.  

Human calculation of the process is currently working for us with the use of experience and intuition and on-the-ground learning, however, this is not easy to scale and we are preparing to scale. 


We are open to a team or professional who can handle specific aspects of this build, even though the absolute ideal would be to have 1 team or professional who is interested in handling the full scope of the AI-related aspects of this gig, including selecting the hardware to run the server, designing the ai, training, and testing, with the target completion date of the project being the moment the calculated parameters gain enough accuracy to achieve a 95% or greater success rate.  

The results will still be evaluated by a human expert prior to each run, but we hope to accentuate that human's ability to have successful runs even if they are newer and training which is not currently the case. 

For this gig, please quote whatever aspect of this you feel qualified to quote.  This is not a role for a beginner or intermediate-skilled person, we need a capable person able to evaluate whether a given strategy is likely to work. 

Please consider:  we are not sure what budget is appropriate for this, so we opened a larger budget for this.  Completion of this project in an effective way with integrity and quality code will likely result in an offer related to ongoing training of the model and upgrading of the system. 

Requirements 
We need to build a model which will accept historical data in these forms
Initial Parameters ( the parameters which vary of various foods to be processed ) 
Processing Parameters ( the parameters we set to achieve the intended outcome parameters ) 
Outcome Parameters ( the parameters which result in the processing ) 
And then be provided with Initial Parameters and predict optimal processing parameters to achieve optimal outcome parameters. 


The deliverable will be a model which we will host ourselves with our own hardware, which will be trainable and which can estimate with a 99% accuracy optimal enough processing parameters to achieve optimal outcome parameters with in an acceptable range. 

Initial research into planning, please critique 
Methods
For the machine learning methods, a combination of regression analysis and neural networks may be the most relevant to use. Regression analysis can be used to model the relationships between the initial, processing, and outcome parameters, while neural networks can be used to make predictions based on the model.


Regression algorithms most likely relevant will include linear regression, decision tree regression, and random forest regression.


Techniques
In terms of machine learning techniques, feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, and cross-validation will be crucial for achieving high accuracy in predictions.

I am seeking assistance from someone who is experienced in Shopify to help me with an A/B testing project. The testing will focus on the following elements:

Product Pages
Simplifying the checkout flow
Two different cart scenarios (page or slider)

Longer Description:
Raw Organics is a Spanish-based company that sells cosmetic products, primarily targeting women in Scandinavia.

We have been hosted on a custom platform for years, utilizing the same design, which has led to an organic traffic conversion rate of 10%. Our success is partially attributed to our control over the entire supply chain and our commitment to delivering products made with love and passion.

However, in late 2022, we decided to switch to Shopify for the purpose of upscaling the business. We hired an agency to revamp our site, but the results were disappointing. The site was poorly optimized and had a customer journey that was different from what we were used to. As a result, our revenue dropped by up to 50% since the migration. We also experienced a loss of rankings and the worst downward trend in years.

Please let me know about your previous experience and the tools you would like to use.

I look forward to hearing from you soon.

Best regards,

title: Untitled Job
description:
The data analysis is regarding the agriculture experiment. Here I will give a brief explanation about the work I have done. 

We cultivated 72 cultivars of a crop in a field with no replications and 24 are harvested early, 24 are harvested intermediate and 24 are harvested lately.

The data I have provided has 72 different cultivars/varieties in which 24 are harvested early, 24 are harvested late and 24 are harvested intermediately. 

The purpose of this work is “ To know whether early, intermediate and late harvested cultivars differ in their germination success, biometry(seed length, width, area), TKG, yield related traits(Flowering time, pod width, pod length, plant height, seed colour and seed yield) ” 

For the germination test we performed 4 replications each cultivar is tested 4 times. For biometry we took 4 subsamples from each cultivar. For yield related traits we collected data manually. All these data are clearly provided in the excel file. 

With the provided data we have to do analysis to know whether there are any changes/differences  in germination success(%), Biometry parameters and yield related parameters between early, intermediate and late harvested cultivars. 

For data analysis: 

Descriptive statistics: Min, Max, Range, Mean and CV for early, intermediate and late harvested cultivars for all the parameters mentioned.

Different cultivars where harvested at different times, so it makes sense to calculate only the average of the measurements per cultivar  
and use this as the response variable in anova and harvesting time as the explanatory variable. 

So the model could be, 
eg: average grain weight per cultivar(parameter) ~ havesting time (ordinary linear model - anova)

all the parameters can be done like the above

Or anything as per your experience which suits for this experiment.

title: Untitled Job
description:
Portfolio Optimisation using GAs

You will investigate the development of a GA-based solution to optimise the weightings of a portfolio of assets and is composed of two parts:

Part 1

The focus of the first part of the assignment is on the optimisation of the portfolio using a GA. To begin with, manually choose a set of assets to work with - which ones you select are entirely up to you, but aim to work with around 10 and also try to pick ones which don't all exhibit the same behaviour (e.g. maybe take them from different sectors).

Then use a genetic algorithm (and the GA package) to identify the optimal set of weights for your portfolio which gives the best balance of risk versus return.

Having done this you then need to conduct a detailed evaluation of the portfolio by looking at how well it might perform in the "future", and comparing it with other possible portfolios (particularly a balanced portfolio, where all weights are even, and a set of randomly generated portfolios).

Finally (for this part) try exploring different weightings of risk and return. The idea behind this it to try and emulate a multi-objective approach and you will need to think about how it is possible to modify the fitness function to create differently balanced portfolios - e.g. at the extremes might be ones which only care about maximising returns or are very risk averse, and in between might be ones which prioritise risk over return and vice-versa. How do the weights and the performance of these portfolios compare with each other and your other solutions?

Part 2

Once you have done this successfully, then try extending your solution to select the set of assets for your GA to work on. The pool from which you select should be reasonably large (minimum of 50) and to begin with you may identify the selection criteria so that this GA operates independently of the one in part 1 (but would pass on the set of identified assets to be weighted by the GA from part 1). Once you have this working then investigate how these might work together (working out an efficient evaluation mechanism is the key to this part).

Further details are given below:

Criteria:

- Construction of a portfolio using the GA package (3)
- Evaluation of the portfolio on unseen "future" data (4)
To do this you will need to keep back some of your data (like a standard train/test split). For example, you might have trained your portfolio using data from 2019 to give you a set of weights. Then, keeping these weights constant, use them to calculate the returns from 2020  data. This should be a very simple calculation. Include your observations on this performance.
- Comparison of the evolved portfolio with balanced and random portfolios (5)
Is the portfolio you evolved any good?  Compare and comment on the performance against an evenly balanced portfolio and the average of several runs of randomly generated portfolios. You could use run this comparison on both the training and the test data.
- Creation and evaluation of portfolios with differently balanced risk and return (to emulate a multi-objective approach) (6)
Within your fitness function your risk and return values will be evenly balanced. Modify this to create a number of differently balanced portfolios which give different preferences to risk or return. Report on the performance of these portfolios by considering how the weights and the performance of these portfolios compare to balanced (and other) solutions.
- Using GAs to select the assets (7)
Use a GA to pick the assets from a much larger set using a defined criteria. Report on the performance of this set (and make reference to the performance of portfolios using the approaches in part 1.
Integrate the two approaches so that the GA which is selecting the assets uses feedback from the GA that is optimising the portfolio. Again report on the performance of this approach, and compare it with others you have run. 

Attached is a link to the submission requirements:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1DCOJfs7UHJojhmSCT47lsN8oFakYqRAtNgAIhVkjYDA/edit?usp=sharing

description:
Dynamic task allocation - for a good example, we can take assigning tasks to people in DHL organization for the flights they are handling 

let's consider the following example scenario for DHL:

    A flight is due to arrive at a certain time and requires a certain set of tasks to be performed, such as loading and unloading cargo, marshalling the aircraft, and refueling.

    You have a list of ground handling agents who are available at the time the flight is due to arrive.

    Each agent has different skills and abilities, and some agents may be more experienced or better equipped to perform certain tasks than others.

    Some tasks may also have additional constraints, such as the type of equipment or resources required to perform the task.

To allocate tasks to agents in this scenario, you could use the following steps:

    Identify the set of tasks that need to be performed for each flight and the constraints associated with each task.

    Create a list of available agents and their skills and abilities.

    Use a task allocation algorithm to assign tasks to agents based on the constraints and agents' abilities.

    Continuously monitor the progress of the tasks and re-assign tasks as necessary to ensure that all tasks are completed on time and to the required standards.

This is just a high-level example, and in a real-world scenario, you would need to take into account many other factors such as the capabilities of the agents, the constraints of the tasks, and the objective function you want to optimize.

description:
Write a python program using jupyter notebook which will predict the possible outcome of 3 balls to be picked from set of 26 balls.

1. For the purpose of understanding we can name it alphabetical balls(since there are 26 balls).
2. As part of guided learning we will feed previous 100 results(the more, the better)
3. Based on previous results each letter will be getting a percentage(to be picked up). Rules of percentage are as below
      a) if a ball has picked in immediate previous pick, the chance of getting that picked will be less.
      b) if a ball has not been picked in previous many results, the chance of getting that picked will be more.
      c)if a ball has been picked twice in a row(previous two pick), chance of getting that picked will be minium(least).
      d) specific ball, which has most picked in all previous(100) results will get less chance to be picked up
       e)specific ball which has been least picked up in all previous(100) results will get better chance to be picked up.
       f) A graphical representation can be drawn for all first prediction and the this will help the next ball. So on for 
       f)Percentage of all the letter A-Z must be equal to 100.

5.  Though the order does not matter, the results are NOT in sorted order(in excel sheet) eg.

 RAT
TOM
PON
QAP
TAP
 Clearly the T,P,A is most occurring letter so the percentage for these letter will be lesser(and equal in this case, as all are 3 times occurring)
6.  Program should auto improvise the results after learning the current result.
7. So, we need to have a way to insert the current output via data entry and should be updated in next ROW in excel sheet.
8. This way program does not have to stop and will be able to match predicted outcome vs the results.
9. Based on the percentage allocated for each letter, the program chooses the 3 random number "with more probability for alphabets(Ball) with more percentage" and "less probability for alphabets with less percentage"

About Us

Zoom Innovations Inc., is a ridesharing company with headquarters located in Ontario Canada. Established in 2012, Zoom Zoom was originally a dispatch based service used for car bookings. Since then, the company has evolved to become a car booking mobile app service for everyday use. The service is known for operating in cities where there are limited public transportation options and much of the population does not own a vehicle. 

Zoom Zoom provides both on-demand and scheduled pickups for passengers in services that range from economy to luxury. 

Zoom Zoom’s mission is to make people’s lives simple all the way through consistent, opportune, and affordable transportation


About The Role

At Zoom Zoom we are looking for a rock star Growth Hacker who is part product manager, part marketer, part engineer, part data scientist, and all-time hacker. Your main role is to test-learn-improve and question everything in order to find predictable and scalable growth processes. As a Growth Hacker, you should have a hustler-like personality, not believing in limits and always striving to achieve the unbelievable. This is a role that requires you to dream big, stay focused on your true north, and then make those dreams a reality by being obsessed with A/B testing, measuring and documenting your progress as you go.

You Will

•	Define and own key metrics/KPIs and build dashboards to monitor them 
•	Find creative ideas to improve KPIs 
•	Continuously A/B test different ideas and analyze the results 
•	Scale and automate growth processes 
•	Collect user feedback through surveys 
•	Use machine learning and predictive analytics to model growth opportunities 
•	Drive massive upticks in user acquisition, activation, retention, and referrals 
•	Work in cross-functional teams with product, engineering, and marketing side by side to tackle growth 


Essential

Requirements:

•	3-5 years of relevant work experience in growth, conversion rate optimization or acquisition marketing 
•	Experience working in a tech product-based startup 
•	Analytical/ Data-driven mindset: Clear understanding of data, analytics, metrics, and statistics 
•	Strong SQL skills; ability to write custom queries and reports 
•	Experience working with visualization tools such as Tableau, Qliksense, Microstrategy, or others 
•	Experience running A/B tests and running growth experiments 
•	Experience in CRM and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Braze, Optimizely 
•	Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams 
•	Outstanding organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment 
•	Creativity and curiosity 


Desirable

•	Computer science or engineering background 
•	Experience in machine learning 
•	Proficiency in any programming language 
•	Experience with Mobile Apps

title: Untitled Job
description:
Our client is the Charles Darwin Foundation (CDF) and we need an expert full stack developer to help us deliver a totally redesigned website and donor engagement portal for them. We are looking for a specialized resource to work with us on the technical side of the project while we focus on the communications side.

For over 60 years, the Charles Darwin Foundation (CDF), an international non-profit organization, has been the premier research institution dedicated solely to the conservation and sustainability of the Galapagos Islands. CDF scientists are leaders in their fields and provide opportunities, access, and partnerships for other scientists worldwide. 

PRIMARY WEBSITE GOALS	

Top priority
•	Grow high volume small donations online & generate large donation leads
•	Grow database of contacts for potential leads
•	Increase brand awareness and interest in their work
•	Position CDF at the forefront of conservation work in Galapagos and ETP

Second priorities
•	Be the repository and go to site of information for all things Galapagos as the premier scientific institution
•	Make scientific information freely, easily and readily available
•	Connect with local population, inform and engage
•	Attract high caliber talent (recruitment & collaborations)


AUDIENCE & USERS	

Audience 1: Donors

Audience 2: Scientists, researchers and academics

Audience 3: Visitors of the Charles Darwin Research Station (their campus)

Delegations 
•	Talent: Future employees and volunteers, current staff and alumni
•	Local population: communities, schools and guides
•	Institutions: GNP, local and national institutions

Audience 4: Media and Press: contacts, press releases, blogs, media kit (photos) etc.


USER EXPERIENCE & VISUAL DESIGN REQUIREMENTS	

•	Challenge statement(s) identification
•	High-level site architecture
•	High-level user flows and use cases
•	Ideation
•	Sketching / wireframing
•	Identification of templates and reusable components
•	Design system to support the responsive solution

Useful Peer references
•	Galapagos Conservancy https://www.galapagos.org/
•	Rainforest Trust https://www.rainforesttrust.org/
•	Smithsonian Institute of Tropical Research https://stri.si.edu/
•	CDF – mock website developed by volunteer in the past http://www.cdfdev.mrjoemorgan.com/ (good reference for a homepage with impact)

Technical features and requirements	
•	Fundraise Up integration
•	Need to have data flow to their Salesforce
•	Need to have subscriber list for newsletter (they use Mailchimp)
•	Need to have features to easily capture emails of visitors to build their database
•	Need to play videos. Their website should be able to handle lots of imagery
•	Need to be editable by a non-technical team, so easy to use
•	Need a dynamic staff directory
•	Need excellent SEO / SEM for both organic and digital marketing – they conduct keyword research via Google Analytics and have used Semrush in the past, but it’s not optimal.
•	Need pixel conversion, tracking etc.
•	Need plugins/code to replace tailored solutions they have:
o	Structured information of the science programs and projects. Staff and content relationship.
o	dataZone: Integration to Natural History Collections database, species search, species checklists, meteorological stations data.
o	Publications.
o	All code generated must be delivered.
Security will also be absolutely KEY on the new website.

V.	IN-HOUSE REQUIREMENTS	

CDF needs to be able to manage, upgrade and maintain the website 100% themselves. Your backend solution for the new site MUST be able to deliver this.

VIII.	ONLINE MARKETING & SEO	

Their website is their shop window to the world. Being remotely located in Galapagos, they need to use it as a tool for effective marketing. SEO is absolutely key.
 
They currently have relatively good SEO and need to keep it that way.

Tagging of pages and appropriate key words will need to be a priority for best-in-class results search in Google and other search platforms – across all priority pages (TBD).


MEASUREMENT & ANALYTICS	

They want to collect, configure, and analyze their data using Google Analytics 4. It is key that they are able to track page views and visits, time on the page, etc. for future optimization and improvements.

The ultimate measure of success of the page will be number of donations via the website.

TIMING	

Plan to launch the first part in June 2023. Priority parts:
•	Fundraising
•	About Us
•	Scientific projects
•	People Directory
•	People / Recruitment

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION TO PROVIDE	

In addition, in your proposal, please provide the following information:
•	Approximate budget (fixed price if possible)
•	Bilingual team capabilities – Spanish / English capacity is a bonus. All materials on their website are developed in both languages and cater to both international English-speaking audiences, as well as local Ecuadorian audiences.
•	Case studies of similar websites you have worked on, especially not-for-profit and charitable organizations

title: Untitled Job
description:
We’re looking for an experienced and very creative persons to ideate based on latest the insights from AI (NLP, large language models, knowledge management, simulation, probabilistic programming), psychology (team dynamics, group processes, flow state), economics and several other fields to accelerate science/R&D. We want to create a highly innovative team for our AI company in Europe in cooperation with a very innovative California organization. You can work remotely in part-time or full-time. Initially, we plan to develop many smaller or bigger technical or psychological ideas worded concisely like in patent claims, i.e. similar to  best-practice/known innovation 1 but extended by new_idea_1 or in synergy with known_innovation_2 due to new_idea_2. Overall, we want to identify the most promising innovation islands and build up the best combinations and roadmaps of innovations in a bottom-up way.
Project description: We’re trying to create a platform to accelerate research with e.g. these aspects:
1.	Systematic situation analysis and solution finding on a scientific basis along scenarios or strategies.
2.	Systematically identify, discuss and decide how to bring strategies and innovations most efficiently forward.
3.	Next level of efficient cooperation and co-creation.
4.	Comprehensive and practical knowledge representation, structuring, visualization and editing components.
5.	Supporting global data, insight and idea gathering with minimal entry hurdles.
6.	Transdisciplinary solutions prototyping.
7.	Embracing everything is in flow: continuous updates and changes in insights, knowledge structures, rules, constraints, classifications, but also economic, technical and natural processes and their simulations, cause-effect relationships.
8.	Applying insights from psychology, team dynamics, creativity techniques, meditation, flow state, etc. to the innovation process.
9.	Synthesizing interests and ideas of various stakeholders, industries and nations, optimizing possible strategies and outcomes.
10.	Integrating insights what works best and what doesn’t work well in DAOs (distributed autonomous organizations).
Your qualifications:
1.	Experienced in several technical and especially AI fields and open to work on topics around psychology, non-violent communication (NVC), diplomatic or management language, modern (agile) project management/sociocracy/DAOs/design thinking, creativity techniques, (group) flow state up to conscious communication.
2.	Ideally vast personal experience from projects/organizations that didn’t work well and ideas what can be done to optimize this.
3.	Interest in cognitive research, e.g. how to learn from dysfunctions and errors humans or animals make, DAOs (distributed autonomous organizations) especially regarding agreement and efficient cooperation techniques, cybersecurity techniques.
4.	Ability to deal with BHAQs/BHAGs (Big Hairy Audacious Questions/Goals) voiced during brainstorming without being judgmental.
5.	Cooperative creative non-judgmental personality, even when working with people from various other disciplines, possibly even touching political, religious or fringe areas to check out even wilder theories for what might actually work.
6.	Ability to convert very abstract ideas into practical research questions, internet search queries, creative ideas and then into concrete technical vendor-neutral architectures that are implementable and affordable today.
7.	Good ability to draw, describe and ideally explain the created architectures optimized for SWOT (strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats) so that less technical people (sponsors, management, and partners) can understand the vision and that the architecture is implementable with an excellent risk/opportunity ratio.
We’re going to combine the best ideas to several innovation islands and will put them into a pitch deck for further fund raising in California, where our partners have top Silicon Valley contacts. We’re paying for the first hours entry hourly rates, then higher rates based on outputs and will additionally compensate any profits resulting from implemented ideas with 5%.
If interested, please submit your CV or profile here on this platform

title: Untitled Job
description:
Our company is a metal fabrication business.  We are seeking a solution to automate a manual process that utilizes data in our fabrication application to transfer costs from our inventory to individual jobs in our ERP system.
Overview of the current process
Our design department creates fabrication files that in addition to all the data for cutting and fabricating, the file contains material properties and quantities necessary for this transfer process.  The information is currently being exported from the fabrication application in a csv file format.
Each day our process generates multiple fabrication files, and each file contains a couple of line items.  There could be 2 or 20 files depending on how busy the day is.  
We have 2 different fabrication processes that generate the fabrication files.  1.) coil line process – this bends full sheets of metal.  2.) Plasma process – this process cuts pieces out of sheet of metal.
We are currently manually copying the data that is contained in this file to another excel file which we use to compile a full weeks’ worth of job records.  At the end of the week, the excel “weekly” file’s data is manually copied over to another Excel file that is loaded into our ERP.
A challenge in the process is that the transfer will happen on the day that the job is physically fabricated.  The files are created varying from a few days before to a couple of weeks prior to fabrication.  So the timing of the transfer will need to somehow tied to the fabrication activity.
The design software is an Autodesk product – CAMduct which is part of the Autodesk Fabrication product.  Fabrication ESTmep, CADmep, CAMduct | Get Prices | Autodesk
The ERP system is Trimble’s Viewpoint – Spectrum  Spectrum Construction Management Software |… | Trimble Viewpoint

title: Seeking a Creative Video Editor for E-Learning Courses, Social Media, and Animation Projects
description: Job Description:We are on the lookout for a talented and innovative Video Editor with expertise in animation and a flair for storytelling, to join us on a journey of creating engaging e-learning courses, captivating social media content, and informative YouTube videos. This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about turning raw footage into polished, educational, and entertaining visuals that resonate with audiences.What You'll Do:Video Editing: You'll be responsible for editing and assembling recorded raw material into a suitable, finished product ready for broadcasting. The material may include camera footage, dialogue, sound effects, graphics, and special effects.Animation Creation: Some projects will require simple yet effective animations. While custom animation skills are welcome, you can also utilize explainer video software to create engaging animations that help illustrate concepts and tell stories.Color Correction & Enhancement: Ensure that our videos are visually appealing with consistent color and quality, enhancing the overall look and feel of the content.Content Stabilization: Utilize Sony Catalyst for video stabilization to ensure smooth, professional-quality footage, primarily shot on a Sony ZV-E10 camera.Stock Video Integration: Seamlessly integrate stock videos into projects. While we prefer to shoot original content or use free resources, we're open to purchasing stock videos or images if necessary.Project Details:The videos will range from vlog-style and interview-style to talking head videos, aimed at educational and promotional purposes.Each video will be approximately 2-4 minutes long.The project will kick off with a test job consisting of 1 animation explainer video and 1 YouTube video, for which scripts and concepts will be provided.Who You Are:Proficient in video editing and animation software, with a preference for candidates familiar with Sony Catalyst.Creative and capable of interpreting a story or concept to bring it to life visually.Experience in creating e-learning content, social media videos (TikToks, reels), and YouTube videos.Able to source and effectively use stock video content, with a keen eye for detail and aesthetics.Looking for a long-term collaboration, willing to grow and evolve with the project.How to Apply:Please submit your proposal including:Your bid per video.A detailed portfolio showcasing your video editing and animation work.A brief description of your experience with e-learning content, if applicable.Any previous experience with Sony cameras and Sony Catalyst for stabilization.This project is not just about technical skills; it's about creativity, storytelling, and the ability to captivate an audience. If you're passionate about making impactful videos and ready for a long-term collaboration, we'd love to hear from you.Pricing & Proposal Details:For this project, we're looking for clarity and simplicity in pricing, which is why we're requesting all applicants to provide a flat rate quote per video. This will help us understand your pricing structure upfront and ensure that we're on the same page regarding budgeting for the project.When submitting your proposal, please include:Your flat rate per video: Specify your cost for each video, considering that each piece will be between 2-4 minutes long. This rate should encompass all the tasks mentioned, from editing and color correction to animation and integrating stock footage.This approach will allow us to focus on creating high-quality content together without worrying about fluctuating costs. Your quote will play a significant role in the selection process, as we value transparency and fairness in collaboration.We're excited to hear from you and see your pricing proposals. title: HubSpot Implementation & Setup For Sales Team
description: We are actively looking for a seasoned professional who can expertly handle the implementation of HubSpot for our business. The ideal candidate will have significant expertise in CRM data migration, building customized fields and pipelines, managing deal flow, and setting up critical integrations with SMS, VOiP, and other software like SalesRabbit.The chief responsibility of this role involves integrating our data from SalesRabbit to HubSpot, ensuring seamless transition and minimal business disruption. Additionally, you will also build out dashboards and reporting in HubSpot to display to the team and management.The primary objective of this role is to build a robust infrastructure using HubSpot to enhance our sales team's effectiveness and efficiency. description: I am looking for an experienced sketch-up designer who can help us create visualizations for our customers showing how we can organize their garages with our cabinets, slatwall, overhead racks and more.The workflow involves a customer meeting, which we do, and then we will bring all the ideas to you to create designs that will meet their needs. This should become a long-term job, working on many projects each week. Right now I spend about 10-20 hours each week on designs. title: Certified personal trainer / physical therapist to write SEO articles for a local Tulsa gym
description: We are seeking a certified personal trainer or physical therapist with demonstrated experience in content writing to contribute articles on a monthly basis for a local Tulsa gym. The selected candidate will be responsible for crafting engaging, informative, and conversational articles aimed at promoting health and fitness in Oklahoma.Requirements:1. Certification or Evidence of Degree/Experience: The candidate must possess certification as a personal trainer or physical therapist, or provide evidence of relevant degree and experience in the field.2. Exceptional Writing Skills: Ability to write in a conversational tone while avoiding generic content. Articles should be engaging, informative, and tailored to the target audience. AI tools may be used as an outline, but then must be human-edited a lot. First-person experiences preferred, avoiding cookie cutter articles.3. Monthly Article Submission: The candidate will be required to submit one article per month. Each article should be approximately 1500-2500 words in length, with a preference around 2000 words.4. Understanding of All-In-One Health Experience: Familiarity with the concept of integrating fitness with physical therapy for a holistic health approach is preferred.5. SEO Experience (Preferred): While SEO experience is preferred, it is not mandatory. However, the candidate should be open to learning basic SEO principles as part of the collaboration.6. Ability to Follow Detailed Instructions: The candidate must demonstrate the ability to follow detailed instructions provided by the project manager, Nicole.Tips and Hints for any article we need:- Use short simple paragraphs that are easy to read (rather than big blocks of text). Numbered lists e.g., Top 10 Tips… work well and are easy to read.- Include a conclusion at the end of the article that quickly summarizes your main points – this is a great way to make sure your all-important big Keywords are repeated one last time at the very end of your article.- include a call to action, like contact us to start personal training, etc- while AI like ChatGPT may be used, please ensure there is plenty of human/expert editing of any AI output, otherwise Google may not rank the content- if you need some grammar help, free Grammarly generally has good suggestions to clarify and set the tone you want. I can also do some light editing as neededThe site is gobeyondthegym.com, call to action could be for example “contact us / call us for more information / to start personal training”The gym is next door to their clinic, both started by a DPT to cover all aspects of recovery and motion.Deliverables:1. Monthly Articles: Submit one well-researched and professionally written article per month on topics related to fitness, health, wellness, and rehabilitation, as relevant to the target audience.2. Keyword Integration (if applicable): Incorporate provided keywords naturally into the articles to enhance search engine visibility, following basic SEO guidelines. Ensure a 1% appearance rate of the article keyphrase in the article, especially in the title, meta description, and some subtitles.3. Internal and External Links: Add a minimum of two on-site internal links and external links to reputable sources for further information. Internal links should direct to relevant services pages on gobeyondthegym.com. External links should offer in-depth explanations or further resources related to the article topic.Budget: $100Posted On: February 18, 2024 04:34 UTCCategory: Article & Blog WritingSkills:Blog Content,     Education,     English,     Search Engine Optimization,     Article Writing,     Physical Fitness,     Health & FitnessSkills:        Blog Content,                     Education,                     English,                     Search Engine Optimization,                     Article Writing,                     Physical Fitness,                     Health & FitnessLocation Requirement: Only freelancers located in the United States may apply.Country: United Statesclick to apply

title: Refactoring Python Project for Stock Picking Regression Model
description: Description:We are seeking a skilled and experienced Python developer to refactor our draft stock picking regression model, “Master Project.py", which is currently a single 1400-line module. The main objective of this project is to break down this massive file into a neatly organized directory of multiple modules while retaining all the existing functionality.Project Goals:•	Analyze the current "Master Project.py" script (GitHub repository to be shared) and devise a plan for breaking it down into multiple, logical modules.•	The primary function should be refactored such that "input_investment" is the only required input variable. All other variables should be set as optional inputs with default values (e.g., "input_maxassets=10").•	Ensure that after refactoring, all functionality remains exactly as it did before.•	Write clear and maintainable code, following best practices and coding standards.•	Provide documentation for the new code structure, covering how the modules interact and guidelines for future developers on how to maintain and update the codebase.Key Deliverables:•	A refactored codebase with the main function and several supporting modules within a directory structure.•	Detailed documentation on the new codebase structure and module interaction.•	A comprehensive test suite ensuring all functionality remains consistent with the previous version of the software.•	A report detailing the refactoring process, decisions made, and any recommendations for future maintenance or enhancements.Preferred Qualifications:•	Proven experience in Python software development and refactoring complex codebases.•	Familiarity with financial models and regression analysis.•	Strong knowledge of software development best practices, including testing and documentation.•	Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.•	Good communication skills and a willingness to discuss the project regularly with our team.Payment Terms:The total budget for the project is $90. Payment will be released in the following milestones:•	20% upon completion of a detailed plan for refactoring.•	40% upon delivery of the refactored codebase, along with documentation.•	40% after the passing of all tests and final approval by our team, ensuring full functionality and performance.Application Requirements:Please provide examples of previous work, especially where you have refactored complex Python codebases.Outline your approach to refactoring - we are particularly interested in how you will ensure that all features of the original code are retained.Provide an estimate of the time required to complete the project.Include any questions you have about the project in your application.To apply, submit your proposal detailing your experience, approach, and how you meet the qualifications above. Also, include your preferred milestone structure if it differs from what is outlined here. We are looking to move quickly on this project, so please also note your availability to start and your estimated completion time.Thank you for your interest in our project!Budget: $90Posted On: February 18, 2024 04:33 UTCCategory: Scripting & AutomationSkills:Scripting,     Python,     Machine Learning,     PyQt,     Qt Framework,     pandas,     Packaging DesignSkills:        Scripting,                     Python,                     Machine Learning,                     PyQt,                     Qt Framework,                     pandas,                     Packaging DesignCountry: United Statesclick to apply

title: Provide a quote for task -  indicator/ strategy
description: - Indicator / strategy conditions need to work individually as well- multi time frame analysisBuy Signal Conditions:•	RSI is in oversold range (below a certain threshold, e.g., RSI  30).•	Bullish divergence is detected between price and an oscillator (e.g., RSI).•	OBV (On-Balance Volume) is trending upwards, indicating increasing buying pressure.•	Price is trading above the EMA (Exponential Moving Average), suggesting bullish momentum.Sell Signal Conditions:•	RSI is in overbought range (above a certain threshold, e.g., RSI 70).•	Bearish divergence is detected between price and an oscillator (e.g., RSI).•	OBV is trending downwards, indicating increasing selling pressure.•	Price is trading below the EMA, suggesting bearish momentum.Toggling Conditions:•	The indicator should provide the ability to toggle specific conditions on and off. For example, I should be able to enable or disable the RSI, OBV, and EMA conditions individually based on my preference. This flexibility will allow me to customize the indicator according to different market conditions and trading strategies.Adjustable Parameters:•	It’s essential that the parameters for each condition are adjustable within the indicator’s settings. For instance, I should be able to specify the RSI range for oversold and overbought conditions (e.g., RSI ranging from 30 to 40 for oversold), as well as adjust other parameters such as the length of the EMA period or the sensitivity of the divergence detection.Examples of Adjustable RSI Ranges:•	In particular, for the RSI condition, it would be beneficial to specify ranges such as 30-40 for oversold and 60-70 for overbought, allowing for more precise customization of trading signals based on RSI levels.Posted On: February 14, 2024 04:01 UTCCategory: Scripting & AutomationSkills:Pine Script,     PythonSkills:        Pine Script,                     PythonCountry: Australiaclick to apply

title: Stock Market Trading System RFP - POC Submission Required
description: Advanced Machine Learning Specialist for Stock Market Trading Analysis (POC Submission Required)**Job Overview:**We are on the lookout for a deeply skilled Machine Learning Specialist to spearhead the development of a Proof of Concept (POC) for an innovative machine learning application tailored for stock market trading analysis. This pivotal project is an integral component of a Request for Proposal (RFP) aimed at launching a comprehensive trading system backed by $25M in capital. The selected candidate will undertake responsibilities encompassing data gathering, the creation of diverse machine learning models, and rigorous backtesting, forward testing, and optimization efforts. The culmination of this project involves crafting a detailed report, devising a scalable solution architecture, and delivering a succinct presentation that highlights the findings and suggests a viable solution.**Critical Project Phase: POC Submission**To be considered for the full-scale project, applicants must first submit a Proof of Concept (POC) that demonstrates their proficiency and innovative approach to solving the challenges posed by stock market trading analysis using machine learning technologies. This POC is a mandatory step to assess the candidate's capabilities and alignment with the project's goals.**POC Requirements:**- **Data Collection Mini-Project:** Gather a small but relevant dataset from publicly available financial market sources. Clean and prepare this data for analysis.- **Model Development:** Develop a simplified machine learning model that demonstrates your ability to predict stock market trends or prices. Explain your choice of model, features, and the rationale behind your approach.- **Preliminary Results:** Provide initial backtesting results showcasing the model's performance. Include any insights or observations from this phase.- **Conceptual Solution Architecture:** Outline a basic solution architecture that could scale this model for larger datasets and real-time analysis.- **Short Presentation:** Prepare a brief presentation (5-10 slides) summarizing your POC approach, findings, and how it can be scaled to meet the project's requirements.**Full Project Responsibilities:**Upon successful evaluation of the POC, the candidate will be tasked with:- Extensive data collection and cleaning from varied sources.- Building and training comprehensive machine learning models for in-depth stock market trading analysis.- Detailed backtesting, forward testing, and optimization to refine model performance.- Developing a scalable solution architecture for a $25M capital deployment trading system.- Compiling a comprehensive report and a presentation that encapsulates the project's scope, findings, and the proposed scalable solution.**Application Process:**To apply, please submit the following:- A cover letter highlighting your machine learning project experiences, particularly in stock market analysis.- Your resume/CV, detailing relevant skills and accomplishments.- Examples or case studies of similar projects you've spearheaded.- A brief proposal that outlines your envisioned approach for this project, including any initial model or technique preferences.- **Your POC submission** as outlined above, demonstrating your capability to tackle this project's challenges.**Note:** Only applications accompanied by a completed POC will be considered for the full project engagement. This is your opportunity to showcase your expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills in the realm of machine learning and stock market analysis. POCs are required for RFP submission.We eagerly anticipate your innovative solutions and how they might redefine our trading strategies through cutting-edge machine learning methodologies.Hourly Range: $75.00-$400.00Posted On: February 14, 2024 03:56 UTCCategory: Full Stack DevelopmentSkills:Python,     Stock Market,     Trading Automation,     Solution Architecture,     Software DesignSkills:        Python,                     Stock Market,                     Trading Automation,                     Solution Architecture,                     Software DesignCountry: United Statesclick to apply

title: Drone Litigation Course
description: This course, titled "Drone Law and Litigation: Theory and Practice," is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the legal framework governing drone usage, alongside practical experience through mock trial simulations. The curriculum is structured over a 15-week semester, blending theoretical knowledge with real-world applications to equip students with a robust understanding of drone laws, privacy issues, safety regulations, and the complexities of litigation in this rapidly evolving field.Course Overview:Weeks 1-2: Introduction to Drones and Legal LandscapeObjective: Familiarize students with drone technology, its applications, and the legal landscape.Activities: Lectures on drone types, uses, and an overview of pertinent laws and regulations.Weeks 3-4: Real Cases ExplorationObjective: Analyze real-life drone-related legal cases to understand trespass and privacy violations.Activities: Case study discussions and analysis to highlight legal implications and outcomes.Weeks 5-6: Mock Trial PreparationObjective: Introduce students to the mock trial process, including trial structure and participant roles.Activities: Workshops on courtroom etiquette, and selecting real drone-related cases for simulation.Weeks 7-8: Mock Trial Script WritingObjective: Develop legal arguments and prepare scripts for the mock trial.Activities: Group sessions for scriptwriting, focusing on prosecution and defense strategies.Weeks 9-10: Mock Trial RehearsalsObjective: Rehearse roles, refine arguments, and practice courtroom procedures.Activities: Mock trial rehearsals and peer review sessions for feedback.Weeks 11-12: Mock Trial PresentationsObjective: Conduct mock trials to apply theoretical knowledge in simulated real-world scenarios.Activities: Execution of mock trials with roles played by students, observed by faculty for later feedback.Week 13: Debrief and ReflectionObjective: Reflect on the mock trial experience and discuss the learning outcomes.Activities: Group discussions on experiences, lessons learned, and the significance of understanding drone litigation.Week 14: Guest Speaker - Drone Defense AttorneyObjective: Gain insights from a professional in the field.Activities: Q&A session with a drone defense attorney to discuss real-world applications and career opportunities.Week 15: Final Projects and AssessmentsObjective: Evaluate students’ understanding and insights gained from the course.Activities: Submission of reflective essays and a comprehensive final exam covering all course materials.Course Design Notes:Interactivity: Emphasize interactive learning through discussions, case studies, and mock trials to engage students actively.Flexibility: Allow room for adjustments based on student feedback and emerging legal developments in drone technology.Practical Application: Focus on real-world applications, ensuring students can translate theoretical knowledge into practical scenarios.Evaluation: Utilize a combination of essays, exams, and performance in mock trials to assess student learning comprehensively.This course aims to not only educate students about the current legal standards and practices surrounding drones but also to develop their critical thinking, legal reasoning, and public speaking skills through hands-on mock trial experiencesHourly Range: $25.00-$100.00Posted On: February 18, 2024 21:07 UTCCategory: Regulatory LawSkills:New York State Bar Association,     New Jersey State Bar Association,     Louisiana Bar Association,     Connecticut Bar Association,     Drone,     Curriculum Design,     LegalSkills:        New York State Bar Association,                     New Jersey State Bar Association,                     Louisiana Bar Association,                     Connecticut Bar Association,                     Drone,                     Curriculum Design,                     LegalCountry: United Statesclick to apply

title: Male voiceover actor for whiteboard videos
description: Job Description: Male Voice-Over Actor for Video Mini LessonsWe are seeking a talented and experienced female voice-over actor to complete a digital curriculum progress at Joy Education. As a voice-over actor, you will play a crucial role in creating engaging and educational video mini lessons aimed at teaching older kids how to read. This project specifically focuses on helping middle school students enhance their reading skills. Our students are urban youth and would resonate with voices and characters that match their identity and lives experiences.Responsibilities:1. Voice-over Recording: Deliver high-quality voice recordings for approximately 150 video mini lessons. Each lesson will be around 4 minutes in length, resulting in a total of approximately 15 hours of recorded content.2. Engaging Delivery: Bring energy, enthusiasm, and clarity to the voice-over performance, ensuring the lessons capture the attention of the target audience.3. Pronunciation and Diction: Maintain proper pronunciation and enunciation to ensure effective comprehension of the instructional material.4. Adaptability: Adjust voice tone and style to match the content and tone of each mini lesson, ensuring an appropriate and engaging delivery for the target age group.5. Timely Delivery: Meet agreed-upon deadlines for the completion of the voice-over recordings, adhering to the project timeline.6. Collaboration: Work closely with our instructional designers and video production team to ensure a cohesive and high-quality final product.7. Revisions: Be open to incorporating feedback and making necessary revisions to the voice-over recordings as requested by the team.Requirements:1. Experience: Proven experience as a voice-over actor, preferably with experience in educational or instructional content production.2. Vocal Skills: Excellent command of the English language, including proper pronunciation, diction, and intonation.3. Age Appropriateness: Ability to adapt your voice to suit the needs of middle school students, making the content engaging and relatable for their age group.4. Recording Equipment: Access to a professional-grade recording setup, including a high-quality microphone and soundproofing, to ensure optimal sound quality.5. Time Management: Strong organizational skills and the ability to meet deadlines while maintaining attention to detail.6. Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with the instructional design and video production teams.7. Portfolio: Provide a portfolio or samples of previous voice-over work that showcase your range, versatility, and suitability for this project.Join our team at Joy Education and make a significant impact on the reading skills of middle school students. Your voice-over talent will contribute to the creation of engaging video mini lessons that empower students to become better readers.Budget: $500Posted On: February 19, 2024 15:27 UTCCategory: Voice TalentSkills:Voice-Over,     Female,     Voice Acting,     Young Adult,     Narration,     US English Dialect,     American English AccentSkills:        Voice-Over,                     Female,                     Voice Acting,                     Young Adult,                     Narration,                     US English Dialect,                     American English AccentLocation Requirement: Only freelancers located in the United States may apply.Country: United Statesclick to apply

title: Looking for senior backend engineer for US banking app with mobile game
description: We’re looking for a talented senior backend engineer (ideally with some strong DevOps knowledge and experience too) to help our team on an interim basis at first (10 - 20 hours per week) with the possibility for the role to become closer to 30+ hours in future. Ideally on either Americas or Europe time zone for easy collaboration with our small team.We’ve launched a unique product called Moneyworld (www.moneyworld.app) that makes saving money more fun by combining an FDIC insured savings account with a mobile game.A little bit like a tamagotchi meets a piggy bank to help more people get started saving. Our mission is to help people build financial foundations.We provide small cash rewards and moments of delight for saving streaks and we move a weekly recurring deposit via ACH from an external bank account to our bank partner.We have a number of integrations with various vendors (e.g. payment processor for money movement, KYC vendor for ID verification etc) plus a system that tracks rewards, game mechanics, and money flows.Thanks so much for applying and here’s more info on what we're looking for and our tech stack:We are looking for someone with:- 7+ years of experience building backend services with node- Demonstrated experience with platform with multiple services communicating by queues- Solid understanding of relational databases (SQL) and architecture best practices- Able to design, build and maintain AWS infrastructure (based on AWS ECS) using Terraform- Maintaining and troubleshooting networking systems (e.g. be able to setup an AWS PointToPoint VPN).- Automating system deployment, operation and maintenance using Infrastructure as Code and Configuration Management tooling- Solid writing and communication skills to convey the architecture and the pros/cons of making a choice- A passion for re-imagining the financial system to get better outcomes for consumersOur tech stack:- We use Typescript across the stack for the application.- Our API and services are written in Typescript and uses Jest for testing- Our database base is Postgres- In our infrastructure we use: AWS SQS for communication between services, AWS ECS to run our containers, AWS Pinpoint for Emailing. All of this is set using Terraform.- Our frontend is a mobile-only app written in React Native to make it easier for us to deploy on both iOS and Android.- We also use Expo to manage our mobile application to simplify iterating and deploying to the respective app stores.Nice to have:- Prior experience working in regulated sectors such as banking.- Some exposure to IEC 27001 or similar security framework- Knowledge on how US bank transfers work- Passion or knowledge of casual mobile games.- A good eye for design and smooth experiencesThank you so much and hope to chat!Hourly Range: $30.00-$50.00Posted On: February 23, 2024 07:39 UTCCategory: Back-End DevelopmentSkills:Infrastructure as Code,     TypeScript,     PostgreSQL,     Back-End Development,     Node.js,     Amazon ECS,     Terraform,     Configuration Management,     Jest,     VPNSkills:        Infrastructure as Code,                     TypeScript,                     PostgreSQL,                     Back-End Development,                     Node.js,                     Amazon ECS,                     Terraform,                     Configuration Management,                     Jest,                     VPNCountry: United Statesclick to apply

title: Seeking Freelancers for MIT Research on Upwork's Connects System: Share Your Experiences!
description: Hello,My name is Henri Jackson, a predoctoral researcher at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). I’m reaching out because I believe your journey and experiences as a freelancer on Upwork hold invaluable insights that are critical to a groundbreaking study I'm conducting. This study focuses on the Upwork Connects system and its profound impact on freelancers like you. It’s an exploration into how you perceive your work, navigate the platform's policies, and ultimately, how these elements influence your professional life.What's Involved?•	A casual 90-minute chat over a video call – just you and me.•	We'll talk about your freelancing life, how you navigate Upwork, and what those big platform decisions mean to you.•	This is more than research; it’s a chance for you to share your story, reflect on your journey, and contribute to a deeper understanding of freelance work’s evolving landscape.A Little Thank You:•	To express my gratitude for sharing your time and insights, participants will receive a $10 Amazon gift card.Participant Criteria:•	Must be based in the United States.•	Must have been active on Upwork when the Connects system was introduced in 2019.Privacy and Confidentiality•	Your privacy is my top priority. Everything stays anonymous•	If there's ever a question you'd rather skip, we'll just move on.Your perspective is incredibly important to this study, offering a window into the real impacts of digital platforms on freelance work. If contributing to this meaningful exploration resonates with you, I’d be honored to hear your story.Interested? Let’s make a connection. Please reach out to me at henrij @mit.edu to find a time that suits you best for our chat.Your experiences are unique and valuable, and I’m genuinely excited about the possibility of learning from you.Sincerely,Henri JacksonBudget: $10Posted On: February 23, 2024 07:37 UTCCategory: Creative WritingLocation Requirement: Only freelancers located in the United States may apply.Country: United Statesclick to apply

title: Development of a Custom Gaming Hours Tracking Software with Unique USB
description: Hello,We are seeking an experienced software developer or a development team to create a specialized gaming hours tracking software. This software will not only monitor the launch times of games on platforms similar to Steam but will also intelligently recognize and log hours spent playing matches across various scenarios. This project aims to provide a detailed and accurate measure of gaming activity beyond simple game launches.Core Requirements:- Advanced Game Time Tracking: The software must be capable of distinguishing between different gaming activities, such as waiting in lobbies versus actual gameplay. The tracking should be sophisticated enough to understand and log hours based on in-game activity, providing a nuanced view of the user's gaming habits.- Unique USB Stick Integration: A crucial component of this project is the development of a unique, secure USB stick that serves as a hardware key for authenticating the software's user. This USB stick should be designed to be copy-proof, ensuring that the tracking is tied to a specific individual and cannot be duplicated or misused. The mechanism must be robust to prevent unauthorized replication or bypassing.- Software Installation and User Interface: The deliverable should include a seamless installation process, making it easy for users to set up the software on their devices. Additionally, the software must feature a user-friendly interface that displays comprehensive gaming activity. description: How to Find a C-GNotesThis article will address ways to find someone to provide care. Start with an acknowledgement that this is a difficult decision first b/c they can’t provide care and second b/c there are so many options.There are 3 ways to find home care:Referral Site – these are large sites with long lists of providers, but little support. title: 100+ Images needed 3D Renders of Product for new Product launch (Preferably using Adobe Substance)
description: We are a premium brand about to launch a large range of new iPad Cases.  We have the CAD for all the shells (that go around the outside of the device) but not yet for the material folding covers.We've got about 5 new product styles, each have approximately 10 images each that we need creating to show the back/front/inside/standing positions, etc.Each of those 10 sets of images will ultimately be needed in approximately 5-10 colours.  (We will have 5-10 colour variations per product type).This is the 1st time we'll be attempting rendered images, and the reason we haven't in the past is that the materials haven't looked real enough.  We want them to look like photographs, essentially.  With the same photography style we use today on our images.It's super important the 100%.There are 4 parts to each image:1) the shell/bumper which we have in CAD already2) the internal lining3) the external PU4) the iPad itself (currently, without screen as we won't know the screen image until Apple launches it).First job will be just a trial to create the renders of the covers for the iPad (see example attached) with the iPad inside, so we can try and replicate 1 or 2 existing test.   Once happy, we can agree timeline and cost for the rest of the job.   Needs to be finished total by end of March.Please send thru any questions and/or similar products you've done before and also availability as it's quite a big project and we need 100% assurance that it'll be done on time as we've had Upworkers go AWOL in the past.Looking to start 1st stage of the project ASAP this week to test viability.ThanksPosted On: February 19, 2024 13:55 UTCCategory: 3D Modeling & RenderingSkills:3D Rendering,     Adobe Substance 3D,     Graphic DesignSkills:        3D Rendering,                     Adobe Substance 3D,                     Graphic DesignCountry: United Kingdomclick to apply

title: Remove vulnerability by disabling SSL 2.0/3.0 and use TLS 1.2
description: This project aims to enhance security on a legacy Linux server by disabling outdated and vulnerable SSL/TLS protocols and implementing more robust encryption standards. title: Beta readers for a 200K fantasy novel
description: Final round of beta readers for a multi-pov fantasy novel:Magic is dead. The Order spent the last few millennia purging it from the world. Over time, magic was reduced to folklore and fairytales, or forgotten completely. Now, most people believe it never existed in the first place. Someone, or something, is trying to bring it back.Thomas Kemp, a promising initiate, grapples to find his place in an organization whose sole responsibility is to exterminate the arcane, while knowing full well that magic is in his blood.Tanya Ringholder, an assassin for hire, tries to stay one step ahead of shadows, betrayals, and past mistakes that she can never seem to outrun.David Trueheart, a musician in way over his head, resorts to more desperate means to clear an outstanding debt with folks that kill for sport.Rigel Cross, a slave to the sands, claws his way toward freedom one corpse at a time.Scarlett Reinholm, a former student at the Academy, just wants to be left alone in her little piece of a desolate wilderness. Unfortunately, someone from her shrouded past has other plans.Gerard Stockworth, a Justiseer for hire, struggles with a particularly obstinate severed head as he toes the line of morality to give his horse a better life.A mysterious man wakes with no memory of who he is or how he got there. As he searches for clues to his past he discovers a community with bigger problems than his amnesia.Struggling to survive in a world ravaged by war, slavery, and corrupt nobility, each of our characters are drawn toward an arcane cataclysm. As their worlds collide each is forced to rely on the others turn on eachother in a violent tale of love, loss, redemption, revenge, friendship, and betrayal.Planning to use google docs.The novel is near completion having gone through around 20 other readers/editors.
